The data on this page only includes cases confirmed in Colorado residents.
*The unknown/unvaccinated category includes people with no documented doses of measles vaccine more than 14 days before symptom onset.
Among Colorado’s cases, 10 are associated with an out-of-state traveler who flew while infectious.
Four were passengers on the Turkish Airlines flight with the index case, five were at Denver International Airport during the exposure period, and one is a contact of a secondary case.
